name: Neural Light Field (NeLF)
definition: A method for efficient novel view synthesis that represents a 3D scene as a Neural Light Field (NeLF) rather than a Neural Radiance Field (NeRF). It maps camera ray origin and direction directly to RGB values, avoiding ray-marching and iterative sampling.
summary: Neural Light Field directly maps camera rays to pixel color using a deep residual MLP, bypassing NeRF's volumetric ray-marching for significantly faster rendering.
